info.description: Company-bound client workflows shared with the CLI: posting, correction, reconciliation, close, account defaults and fiscal periods, plus statement imports. Additive snapshot; routes and envelopes remain v1. Decimal amounts are strings. All 64-bit integers are canonical decimal strings; *_cents means minor units of the owning currency. No currency conversion. Server configuration v2 adds independent post and manage grants. Local registry, migration, restore and filesystem import administration is available in-process, without HTTP filesystem paths.
